DERELICT
SHIFT

File No: 000000

Complete each mission objective, then escape the derelict.

  • Tap an adjacent tile to move.
  • Tap your own tile to Hide for 5 turns and the Alien loses you.
  • Numbers = proximity to alien.
  • Gather scrap ⚙️ to make Noisemakers 📡 and drag them onto a tile to lure the Alien.
  • Drag 🧨 flares onto tiles to light up a 3×3 area for 5 turns.
  • Doors 🟨 require 2 moves to pry open.
  • Airlocks ☒ require a key pass 🎴 to open, and watch out for micro-meteorites 🪨 when crossing the void.
  • Once the Alien 👾 spots you, you can’t hide and noisemakers won’t work.
